full_judgment: 4. The further case of the plaintiff is that Nurul Hoque by receiving an amount of Taka 700 entered into an agreement for sale with the plaintiff on 27-2-1957 to sell 5 ganda 1 kara or 10.5 sataks land described in schedule 'Kha' fixing total consideration money amounting to Taka 2500 and Nurul Hoque subsequently, on 13-3-1959 received an amount of Taka 1000 by issuing proper receipt from the rest consideration money and handed over the possession of the suit schedule 'Kha' land to the plaintiff; that the plaintiff developed the suit schedule 'Kha' land into vhita land and possessing the same by constructing residential house and regularly paid the Chowkidary and municipal taxes and also paid gas and electricity bills. It is further stated that the PS and BS khatians have been prepared in the name of plaintiff but less quantum of land wrongly recorded in BS khatian in the name of others; that the plaintiff filed a case No. 129 of 1963 in the Union Parish ad wherein the Chairman, Union Parishad, by his order dated 24-5-1963 directed the plaintiff to seek remedy in the civil Court. The defendant No. 1's claim is based on an alleged patta dated 15-4-1957 which is a void document. Due to threat of illegal dispossession by the defendant, the plaintiff instituted Other Suit No. 158 of 1991 in the 5th Court of Assistant Judge. Chittagong, for permanent injunction and a local inspection was held in the suit, wherein plaintiff's house and other construction were found in the suit schedule 'Kha' land but due to claim of title and share, the said suit subsequently was withdrawn by the plaintiff. The further case of the plaintiff is that the defendant No. 1 purchased the plaintiff's personal property from Nurul Hoque and claimed title thereof and thus the cause of action has arisen on 12-6-1992. Hence the suit.
